HomePage.title: Mawedly
HomePage.description: A professional booking system for your business — salon, clinic, consulting office, or any appointment-based service — with a deposit that protects your appointments, in Arabic and English.
HomePage.directionNote: This text is aligned to the left, with the side bar on the left, because English reads left-to-right (LTR).

Login.title: Sign in

Settings.title: Business settings
Settings.subtitle: Your business details, public link, and bank account for receiving deposits.

hints.slug: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, e.g. my-salon
hints.phone: Digits only in international format without +, e.g. 9665XXXXXXXX
hints.qr: PNG, JPG, or WEBP, up to 5 MB.

errors.slugFormat: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

messages.fileTooLarge: The image exceeds the allowed size.
messages.unauthorized: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
